transcript: In a very big city, two people, a woman and a man, were walking on a street. Suddenly, they both reached a corner. They hit each other. In the head, they are a little bit heard and confused. Curiously, both have a green suitcase. Both look very similar. In the middle of the destruction they just get together and put together and then each one of them take one of the suitcases and apologize in for the confusion they just said bye. Each one of them take their own path. Suddenly when they opened the suitcase they realized that they switched the suitcases cases. So he ended with a very woman feminine red blouse while she ended with a yellow tie.
